REMOVAL OF PROPELLER SHAFT

1. DISCONNECT PROPELLER SHAFT FLANGE FROM FLANGE ON DIFFERENTIAL

(a) Place matchmarks on the flanges.
(b) Remove the four bolts and nuts.

Marks

PR0001

2. REMOVE CENTER SUPPORT BEARING FROM BODY

3. REMOVE PROPELLER SHAFT

(a) Remove the center bearing mounting bolts.
(b) Pull out the propeller shaft from the transmission.
(c) Insert SST in the transmission to prevent oil leakage.
